title: Understanding psychological resilience: a longitudinal environment-wide association study in Hong Kong
abstract: Nature Mental Health, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44220-026-00742-1 Ke Ning, Kim, Fan et al. use an environment-wide association study to systematically map potential predictors of psychological resilience across a large longitudinal cohort from Hong Kong. By examining a broad range of individual, social and environmental factors prospectively, the study provides a comprehensive framework for investigating resilience in a non-Western population.
